submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective detector for the word 'of' (peaking on 'of' itself or on its complement word) that fires only when the head-noun + complement pairing forms a conventionalized 'X of Y' unit: fixed collocations ('thing of beauty', 'drug of choice', 'powerhouse of the cell', 'book of poems', 'land of the free'), evaluative predicative 'be of ADJ N' ('of great concern', 'of little value', 'of paramount significance'), and quantifier/superlative idioms ('of all kinds', 'of the century', 'Pick of the Week', partitive-relative 'of which'). It stays at baseline for other prepositions in identical frames and for productive measure/substance pairings ('cups of sugar', 'bowls of rice', 'fossils of sugar'), with only weak activation for loosely licensed frequent pairings ('capital of France').
